name: Dripstone Mantis
summary: A stony, long-limbed mantis that hangs among stalactites and drops onto anyone walking beneath.
description: Dripstone mantises spend their lives upside down, growing a crust of mineral scale until they're indistinguishable from the rock around them. They wait weeks between meals. Cave guides tap the ceilings ahead with long poles, and count it a good day when nothing taps back.

traits.name: Drop Ambush
traits.text: If the mantis drops at least 10 feet from a ceiling into a space within 5 feet of a creature, that creature must succeed on a {dc:dex} Dexterity saving throw or take {dmg:2d6:bludgeoning} and have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. The mantis takes no damage from the fall.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the mantis remains motionless on a ceiling, it is indistinguishable from a cluster of stalactites.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The mantis can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mantis makes two Raptorial Claw attacks.

actions.name: Raptorial Claw
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:dex}) from one of two claws.
